import os, sys, sqlite3, unittest
from unittest import mock
sys.path.insert(0, os.getcwd())
from src.repository import initialize, list_contacts
from src.api import handle_add, handle_import
import src.service
from src.service import import_contacts

class ImportContactsTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.c = sqlite3.connect(":memory:")
        initialize(self.c)

    def tearDown(self):
        self.c.close()

    def test_insert_update_and_normalization(self):
        handle_add(self.c, {"email": "a@b.com", "name": "Old"})
        result = handle_import(self.c, {"contacts": [
            {"email": "  A@B.com ", "name": " New "},
            {"email": "c@d.org", "name": "Carl"},
        ]})
        self.assertEqual(result, {"inserted": 1, "updated": 1})
        self.assertEqual(list_contacts(self.c), [("a@b.com", "New"), ("c@d.org", "Carl")])

    def test_same_name_counts_as_updated(self):
        handle_add(self.c, {"email": "a@b.com", "name": "Same"})
        self.assertEqual(import_contacts(self.c, [{"email": "a@b.com", "name": "Same"}]),
                         {"inserted": 0, "updated": 1})

    def test_empty_batch(self):
        self.assertEqual(import_contacts(self.c, []), {"inserted": 0, "updated": 0})
        self.assertEqual(handle_import(self.c, {"contacts": []}), {"inserted": 0, "updated": 0})
        self.assertEqual(list_contacts(self.c), [])

    def test_invalid_batches_leave_contacts_unchanged(self):
        handle_add(self.c, {"email": "keep@x.io", "name": "Keep"})
        before = list_contacts(self.c)
        bad_batches = [
            [{"email": "new@x.io", "name": "N"}, "not-object"],
            [{"email": "new@x.io", "name": "N"}, {"email": "x@y.z"}],
            [{"email": "new@x.io", "name": "N", "extra": 1}],
            [{"email": "new@x.io", "name": "N"}, {"email": " NEW@x.io ", "name": "M"}],
            [{"email": "a@@b", "name": "N"}],
            [{"email": "a@b@c", "name": "N"}],
            [{"email": "@b", "name": "N"}],
            [{"email": "a@", "name": "N"}],
            [{"email": "a b@c.d", "name": "N"}],
            [{"email": "new@x.io", "name": "   "}],
            [{"email": "new@x.io", "name": 5}],
            [{"email": "new@x.io", "name": "N"}, {"email": "keep@x.io", "name": "  "}],
        ]
        for batch in bad_batches:
            with self.subTest(batch=batch):
                with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                    import_contacts(self.c, batch)
                self.assertEqual(list_contacts(self.c), before)

    def test_database_failure_rolls_back_whole_batch(self):
        handle_add(self.c, {"email": "keep@x.io", "name": "Keep"})
        before = list_contacts(self.c)
        real_put = src.service.put_contact
        calls = {"n": 0}
        def flaky_put(connection, email, name):
            calls["n"] += 1
            if calls["n"] == 2:
                raise sqlite3.OperationalError("simulated failure")
            real_put(connection, email, name)
        with mock.patch.object(src.service, "put_contact", side_effect=flaky_put):
            with self.assertRaises(sqlite3.OperationalError):
                import_contacts(self.c, [{"email": "one@x.io", "name": "1"},
                                         {"email": "two@x.io", "name": "2"}])
        self.assertEqual(list_contacts(self.c), before)
        self.assertFalse(self.c.in_transaction)

    def test_api_envelope_rejections(self):
        for payload in [[], None, {}, {"contacts": "x"}, {"contacts": [], "extra": 1}, {"rows": []}]:
            with self.subTest(payload=payload):
                with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                    handle_import(self.c, payload)
        self.assertEqual(list_contacts(self.c), [])

    def test_valid_batch_with_api(self):
        self.assertEqual(handle_import(self.c, {"contacts": [{"email": "Z@Y.io", "name": "Zed"}]}),
                         {"inserted": 1, "updated": 0})
        self.assertEqual(list_contacts(self.c), [("z@y.io", "Zed")])

if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
